experiment: R2-52B adaptive hard-stop and separate trailing-exit layer (no max hold) for catalog techniques

frozen_hypothesis.hierarchy: K01 is the sole primary research test. Only after K01 passes, evaluate the catalog aggregate as the second research gate.
frozen_hypothesis.daily_alignment: use every UTC day in the stitched test calendar; missing activity is zero-filled for both policies before differencing
K01: the validation-selected continuous policy has paired daily PW 95% lower >0 versus K01 NONE/NATIVE at 4 bps
using the same selected k sequence without reselection, report cumulative delta at 8 bps; report-only, never a gate
catalog: the denominator is the frozen 29 included ids; no id may be dropped after results are seen
at least 15 of 29 ids have cumulative 4 bps delta >0
for every UTC test day, compute each included id's adaptive-minus-NATIVE daily delta after zero filling, then take the arithmetic mean with weight 1/29; paired daily PW lower of that series >0
a valid zero-trade result remains in the denominator as zero; a failed or missing simulation invalidates the run instead of being dropped
Holm correction uses 29 hypotheses when claims concern the 29 validation-selected policies; use 87 only if claims are made separately for every id-k pair
frozen_hypothesis.holdout_note: 2023-09..2025-12 influenced earlier design, not a clean holdout; 2026H1 checked once after rules and code are frozen
frozen_hypothesis.scope: research classification only. Pass or fail does not gate paper rollout, retirement, active configuration/dashboard/Telegram filtering, or primary_book=C1_AX. All paper switching follows paper_rollout.switch_condition.

ablation_V3: Not part of R2-52B trial accounting or exits. The parent R2-52A V3 ablation remains historical and is not rerun here.

simulation.costs: 4 bps flat maker round trip, PESS funding, delay 1 minute, slippage 0 nominal; 8 bps is report-only under project rule #1 and never selects or gates
simulation.selection: For each included id and each rolling window, run k in {1.0,1.5,2.0,2.5,3.0} on the validation interval from a flat position at val_start, using earlier data only as indicator warm-up. Rank candidates by 4 bps validation minute-ledger P&L, marking any open position to the val_end close without a synthetic exit fee; ties use lower k first. The stitched test policy starts flat at the first test_start and then runs continuously. At later test boundaries, an already-open position retains k, E0, S0, S_t, A0, A_t and anchors fixed for that position; newly selected k applies only to entries opened after the boundary. No position is closed or reset at a window boundary. NATIVE uses the same continuous test calendar. Never select on stitched test results.

input_sha256.market_note: single parquet to 2026-06-30; load_minutes filters open_time < cutoff at read

n_trials_rule: 29 included ids x 5 k = 145 candidate return series; rolling windows are folds, not trials
paper_records: R2-52B hidden shadow start time and source+x3 configuration hash are recorded by the later paper step; this research run touches no paper table

flip.design: K01_FLIP (F3 side *= -1 + E1, mirrored F3 state exit) under R2_52B exits; k per window by select_k_lower (4 bps validation P&L, tie -> lower k)
flip.note: post-freeze id outside the frozen 29-id scope; K01_FLIP_diagnostic in summary applies the K01 criteria as a diagnostic, not a pre-registered gate
